name: Texas Gas West Greenville-Elkton Lateral
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 430: TGT West Greenville-Elkton Lateral, Texas Gas Transmission, Expansion, Completed 20 Dec 2006, KY, cost 14.17 million, 27.5 miles, 80 MMcf/d added, 10 and 12 inch, interstate, FERC docket CP06-22. Verified with url_verifier. This is the only source. The FERC order for CP06-22 was not read because the search tool hit a session limit. Length is 44.2 km, above the 25 km threshold, and it is not the same line as P2518 (Clarksville, cancelled), which only starts at Elkton. No existing row matches by name. Owner name left as the source spells it; no gazetteer match. Capacity is incremental. Route not researched: no route, to be drawn from the FERC filing. Reviewer should confirm with the FERC order that this is new pipe and not a loop already counted in the parent row P0263. Pipeline is likely a segment of the Texas Gas main system, so PipelineName follows P0263.
